tasks.text: Write a new workbook with exactly one sheet 메모, range A1:D8, containing: a table 메모표 on A1:B4 with columns 항목 (text) and 값 (text); a shape named 오늘, anchor C2:D3, text "오늘은 마감일입니다."; a group named 뱃지 of two shapes, 통과 at C5:D6 text "통과" and 보류 at C7:D8 text "보류". No other items. Use the front matter of a spreadsheet (type spreadsheet, format xlsx, schema 1).
Add a shape named 환급 안내, anchored B28:D29, with text "환급은 다음 달 수입에 넣습니다." Leave the 입력 안내 shape where it is.
Move the 입력 안내 shape so its anchor is B28:D30. Do not change its text. Do not move the 신호등 group.
Change the text of 매출 배지 to "매출 +15%". Do not edit 이익 배지, and do not change any cell note.
Resize 이익 배지 so its anchor is F4:H6. Keep its text and keep it in the 신호등 group.
Add a picture from files/org.png as a drawing over H2:J10, and rotate the 입력 안내 shape 15 degrees.
